title: Cartwise+ Ledger Raise on Cartwise Grocery Orders Over-Cap Review Amounts
content:
## Member benefit note — Cartwise Grocery Orders over-cap review amounts

The over-cap amount registered for review on a Cartwise Grocery Orders line billed although recorded as not found is raised according to the customer's Cartwise+ Membership ledger. The raise applies to the over-cap claim value together with any service-fee part priced onto it, before the missing refund standing on the order is taken off, and the raised figure is rounded to the cent:

- when the customer's membership ledger shows **at least 6** period fees charged within the last 6 whole calendar months, the figure is raised by **5 percent**;
- when it shows **at least 1 and fewer than 6** such fees, it is raised by **2 percent**;
- when it shows none, the ledger does not alter the figure.

**Counting months.** Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

### Ledger bands

| Period fees in the last 6 whole months | Raise |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 to 5 | 2 percent |
| 6 or more | 5 percent |

### Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- Figure before the raise 21.50, ledger showing 6 qualifying period fees: 21.50 raised by 5 percent is 22.575, rounded to 22.58.
- Same figure, ledger showing 3 qualifying fees: raised by 2 percent to 21.93.
- Same figure, ledger showing no qualifying fee: stays 21.50.

### Where the month boundary falls (hypothetical dates, today 20 September)

| Period fee charged | Anniversaries on or before today | Within the last 6 whole months |
|---|---|---|
| 21 March | 5 (21 April to 21 August) | Yes |
| 20 March | 6 (20 April to 20 September) | No |
| 3 September | 0 (current month) | Yes |
